prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Carousel redesign for friend selection screen: Redesign the pet selection screen into a carousel layout with interactive preview elements to make exploring pet options easier.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Browse through companions to see who fits your workspace best."}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in prior to adoption certificate screen: Shift sign-in directly before adoption certificate creation so account state is established before official pet registration.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality trait selection screen: Insert a new screen after pet pick allowing users to set desktop personality traits (playful, calm, active) before completing adoption.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "new_pet_traits", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_traits": {"headline": "Select Your Pet's Personality", "body": "Choose how active or quiet your pet should be while resting on your desktop.", "layout": "centered"}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Two-column layout redesign for path selection: Redesign the path selection screen into a two-column layout comparing preset vs custom creation visually without changing copy.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "How Would You Like to Start?", "body": "Pick a ready-made companion or upload photos for a custom pet."}}
4: [adoption, new_flow] Art style selection flow before custom photo upload: Add an art style preset sub-flow screen before photo upload so custom pet creation has clear visual direction.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "new_style_preset", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_style_preset": {"headline": "Select Pet Render Style", "body": "Choose an art style to ensure your custom photo pet renders clearly on your desktop.", "layout": "grid"}}
5: [adoption, incentive] Official adoption seal badge incentive: Display an official digital adoption seal badge component on the adoption certificate screen upon entering pet details.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"hint": "Complete certificate details to seal your companion's official registration badge.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Official Registration Seal", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
6: [home, layout] Carousel layout for desktop loading waiting screen: Switch the waiting screen layout to carousel to show rotating tips and pet visual previews while generation runs.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet is getting ready to move onto your desktop workspace."}}
7: [sign_in, hint] Account sync hint on sign-in screen: Add clear helper text explaining that logging in with an existing account restores all previously adopted pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your registered email to automatically sync existing pets and save desktop progress."}}
8: [home, redesign] Full bleed layout redesign for desktop pet initialization screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a full bleed visual canvas showing active setup animations.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Bringing Your Pet to Life", "body": "Initial setup in progress. Your companion will appear on your screen shortly."}}
9: [finish, copy] Desktop interaction control copy on intro finish screen: Update headline and body on the final home intro screen to explicitly explain click, right-click, and drag controls for the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Click your pet to interact, right-click to open controls or hide it, and drag it anywhere on your desktop."}}
